name: 68137 · Omaha, NE
findings: ZIP 68137 (Omaha) has 164 nonprofit organizations. 93 of them (57%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 87 organizations.
Housing organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (22% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 68137 (Omaha) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 68137 (Omaha) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 3.4 times the typical level).
